hook: Oil spill on JNTU flyover: Cyberabad police tell riders to *slow down*
hook_b: Oil spill on JNTU flyover: Cyberabad police tell riders to *slow down*
tldr: Cyberabad Traffic Police alerted motorists to an oil spillage on the JNTU-Malaysian Township flyover and warned of possible congestion.

beats.what: The affected stretch runs towards JNTU from Malaysian Towers.
beats.why: Oil on the road makes two-wheelers skid, especially when riders brake hard.
beats.care: If you ride this flyover, police advise slowing down, avoiding sudden braking and expecting delays until it is cleared.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Traffic police asked commuters to plan journeys and cooperate until the spill is cleaned up.

cards.q: Do you get road alerts like this in time to change your route?

qs: Who is responsible for cleaning spills on flyovers, and how fast?
Should alerts reach riders before they enter a flyover?

facts.t: Only the stretch *towards JNTU from Malaysian Towers* was affected, per traffic police.

viz.verdict: Safety advice for riders on the JNTU-bound stretch

watch: Whether the stretch is cleared before the evening peak; check traffic updates before you ride.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Hyderabad: Oil spillage on JNTU flyover, CTP caution motorists

fact: An oil spill made the JNTU-Malaysian Township flyover *slippery* on Tuesday
twist: The stretch hit is the one towards JNTU from Malaysian Towers, so riders heading to Kukatpally were the ones warned.
